englishTranslation: Roasted pork with fine rice vermicelli
atAGlance: Heo quay bánh hỏi is roast pork with fine bánh hỏi noodles, usually with crackling skin, scallion oil, herbs, and fish sauce.
whatItIs: Heo quay bánh hỏi pairs roast pork with fine woven rice-noodle sheets, herbs, scallion oil, and fish-sauce dip. Crisp pork skin meets delicate noodles.
howToEnjoy: Build small bites with bánh hỏi, heo quay, herbs, and rice paper if served, then dip lightly in the fish-sauce dip so the crackling stays crisp.
howLocalsOrder: Order heo quay bánh hỏi as a shared plate. Ask for extra rice paper, herbs, or no chili in the fish-sauce dip before everyone starts wrapping.
worthKnowing: This is a party-platter style dish in many Vietnamese settings: rich pork, delicate noodles, and fresh herbs designed for sharing.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần heo quay bánh hỏi.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of roasted pork with fine rice vermicelli.
